name: carousel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel.scss — generic carousel chrome for <custom-carousel> / home
//  carousel: track, slides, WebGL arrow buttons with progress ring, and dot
//  navigation pills. Layout is driven by carousel.js geometry; this file owns
//  the visual chrome only.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Carousel
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/// BEM block fragment — composed via interpolation so the 'carousel'
/// prefix is declared exactly once (DRY selector rule).
$_B_CAROUSEL: 'carousel';

/// Arrow-button hit area (square).
$carousel-btn-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
/// Dot diameter — inactive nav dots are small squares.
$carousel-dot-size: to-rem($space-md);
/// Pill length — the active dot stretches to a rounded pill.
$carousel-dot-pill: to-rem($space-xl);
/// Gap between nav dots.
$carousel-dot-gap: to-rem($space-xs);
/// Progress-ring stroke width around the arrow buttons.
$ring-stroke: to-rem(2.5);

// Carousel shell — vertical stack of track + controls.
.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, #{to-rem($space-xl)}, 0);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;

  &.carousel--in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transition: none;
  }

  // ── Track ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-track {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    overflow-x: scroll;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) 0 to-rem($space-md);
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none; // Firefox
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    } // Chrome/Safari

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-3xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      padding: to-rem($space-4xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  &-slide {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    overflow: visible;

    &--clone {
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }
  }

  // ── Controls row ──────────────────────────────────────────
  &-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-lg);
    width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem(calc(($un-768 - $grid-max-area-768) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem(calc(($un-1024 - $grid-max-area-1024) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem(calc(($un-1440 - $grid-max-area-1440) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem(calc(($un-1920 - $grid-max-area-1920) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem(calc(($un-2560 - $grid-max-area-2560) / 2));
    }
  }

  // ── Nav buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-btn {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: to-rem(40);
    height: to-rem(40);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;

    @include layout-1024() {
      width: to-rem(48);
      height: to-rem(48);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      width: $carousel-btn-size;
      height: $carousel-btn-size;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    &-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      display: block;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    &:has(&-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
      & > .#{$_B_CAROUSEL}-btn-arrow,
      & > .#{$_B_CAROUSEL}-btn-ring {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    &-arrow {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: 1;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    &--prev:hover &-arrow,
    &--prev:focus &-arrow {
      transform: translateX(to-rem(-4));
    }

    &--next:hover &-arrow,
    &--next:focus &-arrow {
      transform: translateX(to-rem(4));
    }

    &:active &-arrow {
      transform: scale(0.85);
    }

    // Countdown ring SVG overlay
    &-ring {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      transform: rotate(-90deg);
      pointer-events: none;

      &-track {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--grey-3);
        stroke-width: $ring-stroke;
        opacity: 0.4;
      }

      &-fill {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--grey);
        stroke-width: $ring-stroke;
        stroke-linecap: round;
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Indicators (counter + dots) ────────────────────────────────────────
  &-indicators {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  &-counter {
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    letter-spacing: to-rem($space-pixel);
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1; // prevent inherited line-height from shifting vertically
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
  }

  &-dots {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: $carousel-dot-gap;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) 0;
  }

  &-dot {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    // Visible dot drawn as ::after so we can keep a 24×24 px tap target
    // while the visual indicator stays small. Lighthouse/WCAG require the
    // actual element box to be ≥ 24×24 px — pseudo-elements don't count.
    min-height: 24px;
    min-width: 24px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: transparent; // real colour is on ::after
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: min-width 0.25s ease;

    // Visible dot — centred inside the 24px tap target
    &::after {
      content: '';
      display: block;
      width: $carousel-dot-size;
      height: $carousel-dot-size;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: var(--grey-3);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }

    &--active {
      min-width: calc(#{$carousel-dot-pill} + 16px); // pill + extra tap zone
      &::after {
        width: $carousel-dot-pill;
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }

    &:hover:not(&--active),
    &:focus-visible:not(&--active) {
      &::after {
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Fallback (below threshold) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  &-fallback {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none; // Firefox
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none; // Chrome/Safari
    }

    display: block;
    white-space: nowrap;
    > * {
      display: inline-block;
    }

    // Two items that fit without carousel controls form one intrinsic-width
    // group centered in the available row. Without this modifier the generic
    // nowrap fallback starts at the left edge (visible on Nathalia Bond's two
    // tall homepage captures).
    &--side {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-lg);
      overflow-x: visible;
      white-space: normal;

      > * {
        display: block;
        flex: 0 1 auto;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
